entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand is broken. I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-015. I just want my money back.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF886-015. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. The pulse tracker part is not working at all.
I see. And what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's defective. The heart rate monitor won't sync with the app, or with anything for that matter. It's just a useless bracelet at this point.
Understood. Let me just check the policy for you. Okay, I see here the item was delivered 23 days ago.
And? I'm sure that's a problem for you.
Not at all. According to my system, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that timeframe.
Oh. Really? I figured you'd have some other excuse. Fine.

No problem at all. I have processed the return authorization for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. As long as I get my refund.
You will. Once we receive the defective unit back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
